title: validation is the central challenge for generative social simulation: a critical review of llms in agent-based modeling
core_idea: Conduct a systematic review of emerging literature on generative agent-based models that use large language models, focusing on how long-standing challenges—empirical grounding, calibration, and validation—are being addressed; map application domains, categorize reported validation practices, and assess their alignment with stated modeling goals.
tldr: A systematic review aiming to evaluate how LLM-driven generative agent-based models handle empirical grounding, calibration, and validation by mapping domains, categorizing validation practices, and assessing alignment with modeling objectives.
